conclusion: No blocking defect found in the frozen five-file implementation. Proceed to separately authorized real injection/cleanup probe; pure controls alone do not qualify capacity.

confirmed.all_five_call_sites: Static AST inspection finds exactly five executor.submit(paced_lane,...) calls. Each receives the same start_gate variable and duration; intervals remain2/2/2/10/5 seconds and offsets0/0.5/0.25/0/0.
confirmed.deadline: Loop and sleep bound use the common started epoch; a lane waking after epoch+duration does not invoke a callback or receive a fresh duration. An already-started callback may finish after the duration, preserving prior closed-loop semantics.
confirmed.executor_capacity: Six worker slots retain one unchanged disjoint export job and five paced participants; the barrier can admit all five without requiring the disjoint job to finish.
confirmed.failure_visibility: Barrier errors propagate via the existing futures result path; no broad suppression, retry, threshold adjustment or workload/provider modification is introduced.
confirmed.fingerprint: Sustained profile includes arrival_contract=five-lanes-shared-monotonic-epoch-v2, start_gate_participants=5 and start_gate_timeout_seconds=30. result.workload contains the complete profile; seal_result includes it in comparison_identity/fingerprint. New regression rejects old/new arrival pairing and accepts matched new contracts.
confirmed.no_catchup: Existing due=max(previous_due+interval,current_monotonic_after_callback) is retained. Slow callbacks do not produce catch-up bursts.
confirmed.shared_epoch: Barrier action calls monotonic exactly once for the single five-participant admission. Each of the five lanes calls wait once, then anchors its configured phase and duration to that shared value.
confirmed.stop: A pre-stopped lane aborts the gate and returns zero. Broken, missing or aborted admission raises RuntimeError within the at-most30 second gate timeout. Stop after admission retains the prior per-lane check.

Preserve600seconds per role, dataset, intervals/phases, worker/CPU/RSS/container/time limits, original comparator and20percent threshold. optional_calibration_plan.retention: Record both roles, original comparator verdict, all latency/outcome distributions, absolute budgets, required samples, complete independent cleanup and source/fingerprint identities. No retries, selection of favorable runs or replacement of prior failures.
